MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Nurse Consultant





Job no: 944188

Work type: Full time

Located in: Adelaide Metro Southern

Categories: Community and Social Services, Child, Aged and Disability Care, Nursing-Midwifery




 

Southern Adelaide Local Health Network - Flinders Medical Centre - Gastroenterology & Hepatology

Salary $130,190 - $136,010 p.a. (Pro Rata) RNM3| Fulltime - Ongoing Position Available 

Lead, Innovate, Transform: Chronic Liver Disease Nurse Consultant

Join a rewarding role where you will coordinate an evidence-based preventative care program for people living with chronic liver disease, helping to improve outcomes through early screening, assessment and intervention. As an expert clinician, you will provide specialist leadership and work autonomously to deliver high-quality, patient-centred care across hospital and community settings. You will play a vital role in bridging the gap between acute and community services, supporting care planning, rapid response pathways, and hospital avoidance initiatives. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will help drive innovative programs and service improvements that enhance patient outcomes and the delivery of chronic liver disease care.

About you:

Effective leadership skills including highly developed skills in communication, problem solving, conflict resolution and negotiation skills

Registered Nurse and or Midwife with at least 3 years post registration experience

Demonstrated experience and competence in Chronic Disease Management

Experience in the acute care transitions to community sectors

Ability to prioritise workload and meet set timelines

Please see the attached Role Description for additional information.

Want To Know More? Contact: Rachel Wundke, Hepatology Nurse, 0466 777 873, rachel.wundke@sa.gov.au

Application Closing Date: 11.55 pm Sunday 19th July 2026
